raw.query: WITH d AS (SELECT model, variate, resolution, origin, (y_true <= p90)::int AS covered FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus WHERE resolution IN ('15s','1min') AND p90 IS NOT NULL AND y_true IS NOT NULL), cells AS (SELECT resolution, model, variate, COUNT(*) AS denominator, SUM(covered) AS covered_n, AVG(covered::double precision) AS coverage FROM d GROUP BY resolution, model, variate), folds AS (SELECT resolution, model, variate, origin, COUNT(*) AS denominator, SUM(covered) AS covered_n, AVG(covered::double precision) AS coverage FROM d GROUP BY resolution, model, variate, origin) SELECT resolution, COUNT(*) AS cells, SUM(denominator) AS denominator, SUM(covered_n) AS covered_n, SUM(covered_n)::double precision/SUM(denominator) AS pooled_coverage, MIN(coverage) AS min_cell_coverage, MAX(coverage) AS max_cell_coverage, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE coverage < 0.88 OR coverage > 0.90) AS cells_outside_claim, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM folds f WHERE f.resolution=c.resolution) AS folds, (SELECT MIN(f.coverage) FROM folds f WHERE f.resolution=c.resolution) AS min_fold_coverage, (SELECT MAX(f.coverage) FROM folds f WHERE f.resolution=c.resolution) AS max_fold_coverage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM folds f WHERE f.resolution=c.resolution AND (f.coverage < 0.88 OR f.coverage > 0.90)) AS folds_outside_claim FROM cells c GROUP BY resolution ORDER BY resolution
raw.evidence: The effective thesis-corpus view shows pooled coverage above 0.90 at both resolutions and most model-signal cells outside 0.88-0.90, refuting 'for every model and signal.'
